name: dumbbell russian twist (on stability ball)
description: Rotating a dumbbell side to side while balanced on a stability ball. It challenges the obliques and balance.
instructions: Sit on a stability ball and walk your feet out until your upper back rests on it, hips lifted.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands above your chest.
Rotate your torso and arms to one side.
Rotate smoothly to the other side.
Keep your hips high and move with control.
